title: Rabbi Yochanan of Tzafrin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 5, on verse 11, section 2, preserves his valuable saying: the fool says, “Who can learn the whole Torah? Nezikin has thirty chapters; Kelim has thirty chapters.” The wise person says, “I will learn two halakhot today and two tomorrow,” etc.

notes.text: The locator is read as chapter 5, verse 11, section 2, rather than a range of chapters 5–11. The heading is displayed in its supplied Tzafrin spelling.
The consulted Shir HaShirim Rabbah names Yochanan de-Tzipporin. The heading follows the supplied spelling.
